PhasalSubjugator.description: After moving, if there is no friendly Necron Warrior on the battlefield, Anuphet summons a Necron Warrior in a free adjacent hex. If Anuphet does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn. After My Will Be Done triggers, it triggers a second time, but only a friendly adjacent Necron Warrior that was not affected by it this turn can perform an attack. The Necron Warriors have {[summonHp]} Health, {[summonDmg]} Damage and {[summonArmor]} Armour.
